title: Domain Care Auto-Renew Credit for Grace-Period Renewal Charges of Domain Registrations
content:
## Auto-renew credit — desk ruling

**Ruling.** Under Domain Registrations, a grace-period renewal charge billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 and paid by card or PayPal earns, as one of the charge's Domain Care credits, the grace line's autopay credit: USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered where the domain's auto-renew setting is on and no declined auto-renew attempt is recorded on it less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match, USD 0.20 for each year the charge covered where the setting is on and at least one such declined attempt is recorded, and nothing where auto-renew is off.

### Condition combinations

| Auto-renew on the domain | Declined auto-renew attempts on the domain, fewer than 12 whole months before the price match | Credit for each year the charge covered |
|---|---|---|
| on | none | USD 0.50 |
| on | at least one | USD 0.20 |
| off | none | nothing |
| off | at least one | nothing |

### Notes on the records

- The setting is the one the domain carries on the day of the price match.
- Only declined attempts recorded on this domain count, and a month of the 12-month window counts only once its day of the month is reached: an attempt declined on 5 June 2027 is inside the window for a price match on 4 June 2028 and outside it on 5 June 2028.

### Hypothetical case

A charge covering 3 years on a domain with auto-renew on and one declined attempt inside the window: USD 0.20 for each year, USD 0.60 in all.
